style: Say with bright, encouraging energy, like a friendly superhero coach talking to young children
lines: Good morning! Pip just ate breakfast. What next?
One: Brush teeth for two minutes. Two: Skip brushing and go play.
Sparkly clean teeth! Brushing in the morning and at night keeps teeth strong.
Uh oh. Breakfast is still on Pip's teeth. Germs love that!
At school, Pip sneezes into a hand. Then it's snack time!
One: Wash hands with soap. Two: Wipe hands on pants and eat.
Washing with soap for twenty seconds washes the germs away.
Those sneeze germs go right into the snack. Yuck!
Recess! What should Pip do?
One: Run and play outside. Two: Sit inside the whole time.
Moving every day makes muscles, hearts and lungs strong.
Pip's body wanted to move! Kids need about an hour of moving every day.
Pip is thirsty after recess. What to drink?
One: Water. Two: A big sugary soda.
Water is the best drink when you're thirsty.
Sugary drinks can hurt teeth and don't help thirsty bodies much.
After school, Pip has free time.
One: Ride a bike with a friend. Two: Play games on a tablet all afternoon.
Playing outside with friends is great for body and mind.
Some screen time is okay, but a whole afternoon leaves Pip feeling sluggish.
Pip is muddy from playing. It's almost bedtime.
One: Take a bath and brush teeth. Two: Climb into bed muddy.
Clean body, clean teeth, ready for bed!
Muddy sheets and dirty teeth. Pip doesn't feel fresh.
It's bedtime! What should Pip do?
One: Lights out and sleep. Two: Watch videos until late.
Kids need about ten to twelve hours of sleep to grow and learn.
Pip stayed up too late. Tomorrow Pip will be tired and grumpy.
Pip wakes up full of energy. Hero habits!
Pip feels okay this morning. Which habit could Pip change tomorrow?
Pip wakes up tired and grumpy. Which habit could Pip change tomorrow?
When do we wash your hands?
Wash with soap for 20 seconds: before eating, after the bathroom, after sneezing or coughing, and after playing outside.
Yes! Before you eat.
Yes! After the bathroom.
Yes! After you sneeze or cough.
When do we brush your teeth?
Brush two times a day, morning and night, for two minutes each time.
Yes! In the morning.
Yes! Before bed.
Yes! For two minutes.
When do we go to sleep?
Kids your age need about 10 to 12 hours of sleep. Screens off before bed helps.
Yes! At the same time each night.
Yes! When your body is calm.
Yes! 10 to 12 hours of sleep.
When do we drink water?
Water is the best drink for thirsty bodies, at home and at school.
Yes! When you're thirsty.
Yes! After playing hard.
Yes! With meals.
When do we move your body?
Kids need about an hour of moving every day: running, jumping, dancing, biking, playing.
Yes! Every day.
Yes! About an hour a day.
Yes! Playing outside.
When do we cover a cough or sneeze?
Cough or sneeze into your elbow or a tissue, then wash your hands.
Yes! Into your elbow.
Yes! Into a tissue.
Yes! Then wash your hands.
That one is silly!
You found them all!
Wet your hands with clean water.
Add soap.
Scrub palms, backs, between fingers, thumbs and nails.
Rinse with water.
Dry with a clean towel.
Brush the top teeth on this side.
Now the top teeth on the other side.
Bottom teeth on this side.
Bottom teeth on the other side.
Clean hands! Germs washed away.
Two minutes! Sparkly clean teeth.
